title: List feeds coverage only exercises the empty response

evidence.quote: Returns all feeds regardless of active status (excludes tombstoned feeds).

reasoning: The route's intended behavior is to return non-tombstoned feeds regardless of active status, ordered by title, but the associated test only checks that an empty database returns a list. A regression that includes tombstoned feeds, filters out inactive feeds, or breaks ordering would not be caught.
recommendation: Add list endpoint tests with at least one active feed, one inactive non-deleted feed, and one soft-deleted feed, then assert the response includes the first two, excludes the tombstoned feed, and preserves the documented ordering if ordering is part of the API contract.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing test never creates feed rows before calling GET /api/feeds, so it cannot verify filtering, inclusion of inactive feeds, serialization of populated results, or ordering.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create multiple feeds through the API or session fixture, soft-delete one via DELETE /api/feeds/{id}, then GET /api/feeds and assert only non-deleted feeds are returned, including inactive feeds, in title order.
